directAnswer: Disable Live Photos in the Camera app to prevent new Live Photos from being taken, and convert existing Live Photos to stills in the Photos app to save iCloud space.
summary: Live Photos combine a still image with a short video, consuming more iCloud storage. To manage space, disable Live Photos for future captures and convert or delete existing Live Photos.

sections.heading: Understanding Live Photos
sections.body: Live Photos capture a still image along with 1.5 seconds of video and audio before and after the shot. This feature increases the file size significantly compared to a standard photo.

sections.heading: Impact on iCloud Storage
sections.body: Each Live Photo uses more storage due to the embedded video, leading to faster consumption of iCloud space, especially if you frequently take photos in Live mode.

sections.heading: Managing Existing Live Photos
sections.body: To reduce iCloud usage, convert Live Photos to still images or delete them. This will remove the video component while retaining the main photo.

steps.title: Disable Live Photos for New Captures
steps.detail: Open the Camera app, tap the Live Photos icon (concentric circles) to turn it off. Ensure the icon has a slash through it, indicating Live Photos are disabled.

steps.title: Check iCloud Storage Usage
steps.detail: Go to Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Photos to see how much space your photos are using.

steps.title: Convert Live Photos to Stills
steps.detail: In the Photos app, open a Live Photo, tap Edit, then tap the Live Photos icon to turn it off. Tap Done to save it as a still photo.

steps.title: Delete Unwanted Live Photos
steps.detail: Navigate to Photos → Albums → Live Photos, select the ones you want to delete, and tap the trash icon. Remember to empty the Recently Deleted album.

steps.title: Optimize iPhone Storage
steps.detail: Enable Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Photos → Optimize iPhone Storage to keep smaller versions on your device while full-resolution photos remain in iCloud.

faqs.question: Does disabling Live Photos affect existing photos?
faqs.answer: No, disabling Live Photos only affects new photos. Existing Live Photos remain unchanged until you manually convert or delete them.

faqs.question: Will converting Live Photos to stills free up iCloud space immediately?
faqs.answer: Yes, converting Live Photos to stills removes the video component, freeing up space after the changes sync with iCloud.

faqs.question: Can I recover deleted Live Photos?
faqs.answer: Yes, deleted Live Photos can be recovered from the Recently Deleted album within 30 days unless you permanently delete them.

caveats: If iCloud Photos is disabled, Live Photos only consume local storage on your iPhone.
Converting Live Photos in shared albums may not reduce storage until all participants sync their devices.
